title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(有田守研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Arita Mamoru)
educationalGoal: This course will tackle problem solving with an engineering approach to all problems in water from the viewpoints of coastal engineering, coastal environmental engineering, river engineering, and disaster prevention engineering. Specifically, we will try to solve problems using experiments, measurements, and numerical simulations, and present the results in papers and presentations.
advice: In the first semester, we will conduct a literature survey on the background of research themes and previous studies, and summarize the novelty and methods of research. In the second half, data will be collected for experiments, measurements, and numerical calculations. Analyze and consider from the data obtained from them. Summarize the results of your research in papers and presentation materials.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of physics and mathematics, and credits for hydraulics I and II are required.

activityGoals.body: Explain the purpose of project issues
Research methods for project problems can be investigated and an execution plan can be made.
Activities can be carried out systematically based on the project execution plan.
The results obtained from the solution implementation activities can be analyzed
Summarize project results in reports and explain in an easy-to-understand manner

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
